title: Lakehouse = data lake storage with data warehouse guarantees
subtitle: The dividing line is when the schema is enforced and whether the storage layer supports transactions.

nodes.label: schema-on-write
nodes.detail:
structured data only
+ fast queries and governance
- storage cost, rigid schema

nodes.label: schema-on-read
nodes.detail:
raw data, any format
+ cheap and flexible
- weak governance (data swamp)

nodes.label: lake storage + warehouse features
nodes.detail:
ACID, schema evolution, transactions
table format: Apache Iceberg

nodes.label: Lakehouse keeps the cheap open-format storage of a lake and adds the ACID and schema guarantees of a warehouse, through the table format rather than a new storage engine.
